editorial:
Imagine two of the biggest wrestling companies from different sides of the world finally opening their doors to each other. That is exactly what you get here. It feels like a massive party in Chicago where the best athletes from America and Japan clash in one ring. You have huge stars like Jon Moxley and Hiroshi Tanahashi bringing a ton of energy and drama to the screen. The vibe is electric from start to finish, and it feels less like a scripted show and more like a real fight for honor and glory. Whether you are a die-hard fan or just like seeing people hit each other, the excitement is contagious.

What really makes this special is the non-stop action and the surprises. Seeing Claudio Castagnoli make his big debut was a huge highlight that kept the pace moving fast. While some matches are a bit longer than others, the quality of the wrestling is top-tier. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch every hit. Or, if you love owning your favorites, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go. It is a wild ride that any sports fan will love.
endingExplained: The big finale comes down to a brutal battle between Jon Moxley and Hiroshi Tanahashi. After a long and hard-hitting fight, Moxley manages to get the upper hand and pin Tanahashi. This win makes Moxley the interim AEW World Champion. The event wraps up with a feeling of mutual respect between the two companies, leaving you wondering who will face off in the next big crossover event.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves professional wrestling and high-stakes combat.
